qualification_review.interpretation: The shared workspace is limited by data tier, technical compatibility, and project-scoped incident controls.
qualification_review.limitations: Some projects may remain on specialist or existing systems even when the shared service launches.

records.interpretation: The consortium begins with fragmented lab systems and a two-semester grant intended to support a shared September launch.
records.limitations: This describes the initial institutional and technical setting.

records.interpretation: The council adopts a two-semester launch with temporary migration and support staff, Central IT infrastructure services, data-tier admission, compatibility exceptions, incident pauses, restoration testing, and project-level exports.
records.limitations: The signed memorandum has a June 30 staffing boundary and leaves standing unit agreements unchanged.

records.interpretation: Controlled projects and incompatible environments follow narrower admission, pause, restoration, pinning, export, or existing-server procedures.
records.limitations: The shared workspace is not approved for every data class or software environment.
